text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option b 15.0 to 15.8 s. In the overhead view the car rotates slightly and moves left off the bank edge with a curved wake. At 15.4 s a cut to an eye-level view: the white SUV sits half-submerged in wide brown water with a flat-topped tree behind; it tilts nose-down and drifts left with a bow wave on its right. This eye-level shot resembles option a's 15.4 s shot.
